page.layout: One scanned page: a bound book leaf photographed in its binding, with a faint, show-through text block on the paper. No legible printed column, margin or heading is discernible.
page.notes: The page appears blank apart from faint mirrored show-through from the reverse side and stains, a red ink speckle and a dark pen scribble on the left cover/endpaper. The blurred grey printing visible across the leaf is show-through and cannot be read, so it is not transcribed. The binding, the dark scanner border and the scribbled marks on the left edge are not printed text and are omitted.
